name: pink_noise_murmur_source
mechanism: The VSD murmur is synthesized from pink 1/f noise instead of white noise and band-pass filtered to the severity-appropriate 150-720 Hz range, reducing excessive high-frequency zero-crossing rate while preserving the holosystolic plateau envelope.

name: post_bandpass_lowpass_rolloff
mechanism: A zero-phase 2nd-order 500 Hz low-pass filter is applied after the murmur band-pass filter to attenuate high-frequency energy and reduce excessive zero-crossing rate.
code_snippet: b_lp, a_lp = signal.butter(2, 500.0 / nyq, btype='low'); murmur = signal.filtfilt(b_lp, a_lp, murmur)

name: severity_dependent_lowpass_rolloff
mechanism: The murmur low-pass roll-off is changed from a fixed 500 Hz second-order filter to a fourth-order zero-phase Butterworth filter with a cutoff sampled from severity-specific ranges, reducing excessive high-frequency energy and restoring spectral diversity.
code_snippet: b_lp, a_lp = signal.butter(4, lowpass_cutoff / nyq, btype='low')

name: steeper_variable_lowpass_rolloff
mechanism: Replacing the fixed 4th-order Butterworth low-pass with a zero-phase 6th/8th-order SOS low-pass and randomizing the cutoff per recording steepens high-frequency attenuation, reducing unrealistic high-frequency noise and zero-crossing rate while increasing spectral diversity.
